# Dictionary.com
> The world's leading online dictionary for English definitions, synonyms, word origins, example sentences, language articles, and word games.

Dictionary.com combines authoritative dictionary entries with usage guidance, etymology, cultural language coverage, daily vocabulary features, and interactive games. It also connects closely with Thesaurus.com for synonym-focused writing help and reference content.

## Core Reference
- [Dictionary.com Home](https://www.dictionary.com/): Main entry point for definitions, trending words, articles, and language tools.
- [Word of the Day](https://www.dictionary.com/word-of-the-day): Daily featured word with definition, pronunciation, origin, and usage examples.
- [Browse Dictionary Entries](https://www.dictionary.com/list): Alphabetical entry list for exploring words across the dictionary.
- [Search Results for "williwaw"](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/williwaw): Example dictionary entry with meaning, pronunciation, origin, and sample sentences.
- [Terms and Privacy](https://www.dictionary.com/terms-and-privacy): Legal, privacy, cookie, and terms information for Dictionary.com services.

## Dictionary Entries
- [Browse: williwaw](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/williwaw): Dictionary entry with definitions, pronunciation, origin, and example usage.
- [Browse: atmospheric river](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/atmospheric-river): Entry for a current term with meaning and usage context.
- [Browse: Mandela effect](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/mandela-effect): Definition and explanation of a widely used modern expression.
- [Browse: NaNoWriMo](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/nanowrimo): Entry covering the writing-related proper noun and its meaning.
- [Browse: March Madness](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/march-madness): Dictionary entry for the well-known sports expression.
- [Browse Index](https://www.dictionary.com/list): A–Z listing of dictionary entries for broad vocabulary exploration.

## Daily Learning & Trending Vocabulary
- [Word of the Day](https://www.dictionary.com/word-of-the-day): Daily vocabulary feature designed for regular word learning and retention.
- [Popular Searches](https://www.dictionary.com/): Homepage section surfacing frequently searched and trending terms.
- [Trending Words](https://www.dictionary.com/): Homepage area highlighting currently popular words and phrases.
- [This Week in Words](https://www.dictionary.com/): Homepage editorial feature covering notable recent vocabulary and language trends.
- [Featured Articles](https://www.dictionary.com/articles): Editorial hub for language explainers, usage guides, and word-focused articles.

## Articles & Language Guides
- [Articles](https://www.dictionary.com/articles): Main editorial section for grammar, usage, etymology, and language explainers.
- [Language](https://www.dictionary.com/articles/language): Articles focused on language topics, word history, and usage discussions.
- [Business & Finance](https://www.dictionary.com/articles/business-finance): Vocabulary and explainers related to business, economics, and finance terms.
- [Slang](https://www.dictionary.com/articles/slang): Editorial coverage of slang terms, internet language, and evolving expressions.
- [Culture](https://www.dictionary.com/culture): Language-and-culture hub covering slang, memes, idioms, and pop culture vocabulary.

## Culture, Slang & Modern Usage
- [Culture Home](https://www.dictionary.com/culture): Central hub for modern language, slang, idioms, and cultural references.
- [Slang](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/slang): Collection of slang definitions and explainers for contemporary expressions.
- [Emoji](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/emoji): Guides to emoji meanings, usage, and cultural context.
- [Acronyms](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/acronyms): Reference content for internet abbreviations, texting shorthand, and initialisms.
- [Memes](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/memes): Explanations of meme-related language and internet culture terminology.
- [Idioms](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/idioms): Articles and references for idiomatic expressions and figurative language.

## Games & Interactive Learning
- [Games](https://www.dictionary.com/games): Main games hub for vocabulary-building and wordplay activities.
- [Word Puzzle Games](https://www.dictionary.com/games): Collection of browser-based word games and challenges.
- [Vocabulary Games](https://www.dictionary.com/games): Interactive activities for practicing spelling, meaning, and word recognition.
- [Daily and Casual Games](https://www.dictionary.com/games): Rotating game experiences tied to language learning and entertainment.

## Writing Help via Thesaurus.com
- [Thesaurus.com Articles](https://www.thesaurus.com/articles): Writing tips, style guidance, and word-choice articles from the companion site.
- [Writing Tips](https://www.thesaurus.com/articles): Editorial guidance for clearer, stronger, and more precise writing.
- [Synonym-Focused Guides](https://www.thesaurus.com/articles): Articles that help writers choose alternatives and refine tone.
- [Reference Companion Site](https://www.thesaurus.com/): Thesaurus.com homepage for synonyms, antonyms, and writing support.
